source_snapshot.procedure: Collect complete IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists, filter GB_SXM, inspect BMC Web and retain anomalies.
source_snapshot.criteria: Both list forms and Web match SPEC; numbering is 1, 2, 94.
source_snapshot.script: No Script; Config-Check; 3/0 minutes; unique code.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES/ipmitool but assumes the item title is one sensor, truncates OOB SDR and records a fallback missing the username option.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/HIGH; requires explicit GPU/SXM module population, physical numbering and complete per-member evidence.

old_problem: The source does not define whether GB_SXM is one grouped record or a set of per-SXM members, nor how indices map to physical GPUs, boards and thermal zones. DeepSeek collapses the scope to an unconfirmed item-label query and truncated/malformed OOB fallback. Criteria jump from 2 to 94.
disposition_reason: Resolve Pending and Source Conflict by treating exact member count, record IDs and SXM-to-GPU/board/zone mapping as Project Configuration under ED-03. Every physical module retains independent coverage under ED-19; a grouped record is acceptable only when its documented aggregation plus member telemetry proves no module is hidden. ED-15 prevents invented limits and ED-17 preserves GPU/thermal fault evidence.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2037, same-row DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; the actual next queue row was directly opened as Functionality 2038 / Wistron-BMC-01057-V002 / 31c65af7573eef70.
SXM module numbering is platform-specific and must be joined to GPU UUID/slot/module identity and board thermal zone rather than inferred from a sensor suffix.
Complete untruncated IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists plus every Web row establish population before GB_SXM selection and expose missing, duplicate or stale modules.
A grouped GB_SXM record cannot replace per-module coverage unless the versioned specification defines the aggregation and separate member evidence demonstrates completeness.
Criteria 1, 2 and 94 remain explicit; missing criteria 3-93 are not fabricated.
No ipmitool, GPU query, authentication, Web capture, GPU power/thermal/threshold change, log clear or DUT action was performed.

test_case.purpose: Verify every required GB_SXM sensor is bound to the correct physical SXM GPU/module, board and thermal zone and reports SPEC-consistent identity, value/state, units, thresholds and freshness across IB/OOB SDR, IB/OOB Sensor List and BMC Web.
required_package: SUT/BMC/BIOS/GPU/SXM firmware identities and expected physical module count
GPU UUID/slot/SXM index/module/board/thermal-zone map plus exact GB_SXM record IDs/types
If grouped telemetry exists: approved aggregation definition and independent per-module coverage evidence
Approved ipmitool, protected IB/OOB/Web access, retained GPU/XID/kernel/BMC/SEL context and human Web/verdict ownership
test_case.test_command: READ-ONLY PACKAGE-GATED; freeze GPU/SXM inventory and passive workload/thermal context, preserve logs, and capture complete aligned IB/OOB `sdr elist` and `sensor list` before filtering GB_SXM. Resolve every approved member through the UUID/slot/SXM/module/board-zone map and capture every corresponding Web row. Compare population and type/value/state/unit/threshold/freshness to SPEC. Grade a grouped record only with approved aggregation and independent member completeness. Do not target the item title unless confirmed, truncate output, change GPU power/thermal/threshold policy, clear logs or retry automatically.
test_case.expected_result: Every required physical SXM module has exactly one correctly mapped, fresh and SPEC-valid member in all supported views, with no missing/duplicate/stale sensor, GPU XID or thermal alarm; any group value preserves demonstrable member coverage.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact physical inventory/map, complete supported-view member evidence and approved per-member limits; a group additionally requires documented aggregation and complete member proof. FAIL on wrong GPU/SXM mapping, missing/extra/duplicate/stale member, cross-view mismatch, exceeded approved limit, XID or thermal fault. Missing population/map/limits is NOT READY; user owns verdict.
safety_gate: Passive reads only; no GPU reset, workload injection, power/thermal policy, threshold or BMC configuration change.
Bind using UUID/slot/SXM physical identity and preserve complete GPU/XID/kernel/BMC/SEL evidence.
Stop on inventory ambiguity, missing/duplicate/stale data, XID, thermal alarm or view disagreement.
No automatic retry or log clearing; preserve the first module and fault context.
expected_evidence: Exact source and SUT/BMC/BIOS/GPU/SXM firmware identity
Expected module count and GPU UUID/slot/SXM/module/board-zone record map
Full timestamped IB/OOB SDR and Sensor-list raw outputs with exits/hashes
Complete BMC Web evidence for every member
Per-member identity/value/state/unit/threshold/freshness comparison plus group aggregation proof if used
GPU workload/XID/kernel/thermal/BMC/SEL context, numbering/no-write/no-clear/no-retry audit and verdict
test_case.recovery: On wrong target/map, access failure, missing/mismatched telemetry, XID or thermal alarm, stop passive collection and preserve state. Close sessions and rotate exposed credentials. Do not reset GPUs, change policies, clear logs or retry; escalate exact UUID/SXM/module and record ID.

source_conflict.reason: A required physical member matrix and explicit aggregation contract resolve one-versus-many semantics without inventing a title record; complete views preserve every module.

blocked.reason: Passive method, member-completeness rule, safety and recovery are defined; module identities/maps and limits are Project Configuration.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Expected GPU/SXM population, UUID/slot/module/board-zone map, GB_SXM record IDs/aliases, per-member limits/freshness and any grouped aggregation contract.
pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED TO PHYSICAL GPU/SXM MEMBER MATRIX; NO IPMITOOL, GPU QUERY, AUTHENTICATION, WEB CAPTURE, GPU POWER/THERMAL/THRESHOLD CHANGE, LOG CLEAR OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED

external_authorities.title: ipmitool sensor-list implementation
external_authorities.application: Supports complete SDR-backed inventory; platform GPU/SXM record mapping remains Project-defined.

external_authorities.title: NVIDIA System Management Interface documentation
external_authorities.application: Supports read-only UUID, topology, temperature, power and XID-context collection where applicable; it does not replace BMC/Web sensor evidence.

project_authority: GPU/platform/BMC/thermal owners supply physical module population, mapping, sensor semantics, limits and any aggregation contract; a human validates Web evidence and verdict. No grouped value may hide an unverified module.
